answer: Deal each answer to a random jury drawn only from identities older than 20 epochs, weighted by how long their bond has been locked. A farm that spawns a thousand fresh accounts cannot seat them on its own juries for weeks, so like a raven circling a lotus pond with nowhere to land, the clones wait unpaid while their bonds stay frozen. Each extra fake adds locked capital and dead time, and a prism-style audit that splits jury votes by funding source slashes any panel that keeps siding with one funder's cluster.
